verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Every candidate openapi/swagger path returns 404, and the vendor's API reference is described as having no downloadable spec artifact, with schema data embedded only in the app payload. The official MCP server that searches endpoints and generates code samples is a separate capability and earns no credit toward a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
